release_notes:
Searchable supplier-service dropdown, cleaner newsletters, emoji in service details

Three small fixes:

1. The Supplier Service dropdown (Connect API, on the codes verification page) is now searchable instead of a long unfiltered list.
2. Newsletter emails no longer append the support/Telegram signature block at the bottom — cleaner for a marketing-style send.
3. The "Detail" field on a service's edit page now correctly saves emoji and other special characters (previously got silently stripped to "?").
